newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Multisource soars on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Multisource soars on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Multisource Holdings Ltd, which is to be reconstituted as a private investment firm, jumped on Wednesday as investors welcomed the move and scrambled for limited stock.

By 1115 GMT Multisource was up 21.0 percent, or 300 cents, to a new high of 17.00 rand, making it the biggest percentage gainer on the Johannesburg bourse. The firm has rallied more than 50 percent since the beginning of the month. Volumes were, however, slim at 35,400 shares.
"Some portfolio managers are saying it is a good medium term buy," one dealer said.
"There is also not a lot of stock around so with people trying to get into it, the price will obviously be pushed up sharply."
Multisource, a supplier of two-way radio and paging equipment and services, was in May bought out by investment firm MDM Growth Investments at 2.55 rand a share or 22 million rand.

MDM said at the time that the aim of the buy was to shape the firm into an investment firm which would be "applied to private equity investment opportunities". It said that Multisource had cash resources of about 17.5 million rand.
A rights issue was planned for later this year to supplement these resources. Multisource's name would be changed to MDM Growth Investments Ltd.
Neither Multisource nor MDM management were immediately available for comment.
